boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named CU Boulder library study environments, selected across noise levels and campus locations.

cards.title: Norlin Library Science Stacks
cards.subtitle: Silent study · Norlin Library, S180
cards.notes: Bring headphones and settle into the designated silent area; keep conversation elsewhere and use the Norlin floor plan to locate S180.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent-study area in Norlin’s Science Stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Norlin Library Science Stacks (S180) as a silent study location.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Space | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Norlin Library; consult current library hours before visiting. Silent areas permit no talking and require headphones for audio.

cards.title: Asian Studies Stacks
cards.subtitle: Silent study · Norlin Library, S146/S246/S280
cards.notes: Choose one of the listed stack areas when you need a silent setting; use headphones for audio and keep calls outside the space.
cards.short_summary: Three listed silent-study locations within Norlin’s Asian Studies Stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries identifies Norlin’s Asian Studies Stacks rooms S146, S246 and S280 as silent study areas.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Space | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Norlin Library; consult current library hours before visiting. Silent areas permit no talking and require headphones for audio.

cards.title: Art & Architecture Stacks
cards.subtitle: Silent study · Norlin Library, N225/N275
cards.notes: Use the N225 or N275 stack locations for focused reading; keep the area silent and use headphones if you need audio.
cards.short_summary: Silent study space in Norlin’s Art & Architecture collection area.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Norlin Library Art & Architecture Stacks (N225 and N275) as silent study locations.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Space | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Norlin Library; consult current library hours before visiting. Silent areas permit no talking and require headphones for audio.

cards.title: Government Information Stacks
cards.subtitle: Silent study · Norlin Library
cards.notes: Set up here for a quiet work session, keeping the space free of conversation and using headphones for any audio.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent-study setting among Norlin’s government information materials.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Norlin Library Government Information Stacks as a silent study location.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Space | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Norlin Library; consult current library hours before visiting. Silent areas permit no talking and require headphones for audio.

cards.title: Norlin Commons
cards.subtitle: Conversational study · Norlin Library
cards.notes: Use the collaborative work areas for group tasks; reserve a group study room when needed and bring a valid Buff OneCard.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative workspace with technology and reservable group study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Norlin Commons offers collaborative work spaces, technology and reservable group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Group study rooms are for current CU Boulder faculty, staff and students with a valid Buff OneCard; reservations are available in half-hour blocks for up to four hours.

cards.title: Business Library 160
cards.subtitle: Quiet study · Koelbel Building
cards.notes: Head to room 160 when you want low-volume independent work; keep conversation quiet and use headphones for audio.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-designated study room in the Business Library.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Business Library 160 as a quiet study location.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Space | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Business Library is in the Koelbel Building; consult current library hours before visiting. Quiet areas allow low-volume conversation and headphones.

cards.title: Business Library 150
cards.subtitle: Conversational study · Koelbel Building
cards.notes: Use room 150 for collaborative coursework; keep audio in headphones and move into a reservable room if your group needs privacy.
cards.short_summary: A conversational-study room in the Business Library.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Business Library 150 as a conversational study location.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Space | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Business Library is in the Koelbel Building; consult current library hours before visiting. Conversational areas support group work, with headphones for audio.

cards.title: Earth Sciences & Map Library Lower Level
cards.subtitle: Quiet study · Benson Earth Sciences
cards.notes: Use the lower level for low-volume reading or writing; keep conversation quiet and bring headphones for any audio.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study area in the Earth Sciences & Map Library.

cards.source_title: Find Your Study Space | University Libraries

cards.title: Earth Sciences & Map Library Entry Level
cards.subtitle: Conversational study · Benson Earth Sciences
cards.notes: Choose the entry level for project discussion or shared work; use headphones for audio and respect nearby library users.

cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists the Earth Sciences & Map Library Entry Level as a conversational study location.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Space | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Earth Sciences & Map Library is in Benson Earth Sciences; consult current library hours before visiting. Conversational areas support group work, with headphones for audio.

cards.title: Howard B. Waltz Music Library
cards.subtitle: Quiet study · Imig Music Building, second floor north
cards.notes: Use this library’s quiet setting for reading or written work; keep conversation low and listen through headphones rather than speakers.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-designated study environment in the Imig Music Building.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists the Music Library as a quiet study location and places the Howard B. Waltz Music Library on the second floor north of Imig Music.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Space | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in the Imig Music Building; consult current library hours before visiting. Quiet areas allow low-volume conversation and headphones.
